defences.name: Generic Adversarial Training
defences.mechanism: Trains the model with adversarial examples to improve robustness against some unknown or novel attacks.
limitations: No direct evidence (E1) supports effectiveness against the Bullseye Polytope attack or its family; the claim is speculative.
Applicability is highly uncertain without targeted evaluation.

defence_plan.recommended: No effective defence can currently be recommended for the Bullseye Polytope attack.
defence_plan.rationale: There is no direct evidence (E1) that any existing defence, including generic adversarial training, is effective against the Bullseye Polytope attack. All recommendations are speculative, and applicability is very low. Targeted research and evaluation are needed to identify or develop specific mitigations for this attack.
